title: Setoff of Open Earlier-Month Days Against Funding-Month Interest (Closing and Funding)
content:
**Rule.** When a Closing and Funding disbursement moves into the next month, every day collected for the earlier month is refunded; an open earlier-month day is refunded by setoff against the funding-month interest when the borrower pays it. The open earlier-month days are the days of the charge collected at closing (every day of the closing's prepaid interest charge booked on the signing date) that no prepaid interest refund naming that charge has returned.

The setoff is worked out as follows: where open earlier-month days remain and those days at the setoff per diem come to no more than the funding-month interest, the setoff is those days times the setoff per diem; where they come to more, the setoff is the whole funding-month interest and the rest stays with the earlier-month refund; otherwise there is no setoff.

| Open days times setoff per diem, compared with the funding-month interest | Setoff | What remains of the earlier-month amount |
|---|---|---|
| no more than | open days times the setoff per diem | nothing |
| more than | the whole funding-month interest | the excess stays with the earlier-month refund |
| no open days | none | not applicable |

## Examples (hypothetical; setoff per diem 60.27)

- 4 open days come to 241.08; the funding-month interest is 1,851.98. The setoff is 241.08.
- 4 open days come to 241.08; the funding-month interest is 150.00. The setoff is 150.00, and 91.08 stays with the earlier-month refund.
- 4 open days come to 241.08; the funding-month interest is exactly 241.08. The setoff is 241.08.
